retrievalProfile.description: A centered male studio portrait against a gradient blue background with asymmetrical, multi-colored serif typography flanking the subject.
triggerTerms: serif text over blue sky background

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in a dark suit and white shirt centered against a soft blue gradient, framed by vertically stacked serif text in contrasting colors like brown, magenta, and blue.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered as the primary vertical axis
Typography balanced asymmetrically in the upper corners
High contrast between dark suit and light blue background
Color-coded text blocks distinguishing title from artist name
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused studio lighting on the face
Formal attire including a slim necktie

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium-close-up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes and smile, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves to the large title on the top left, then to the artist name on the top right, and finally down to the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper corners occupied by text blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue background and dark charcoal suit.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Crisp white shirt and bright magenta text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm brown and deep blue for secondary text blocks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with low value subject; text uses high saturation to pop against the sky.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Comma in title is oversized and stylized
Descenders are kept short to allow tight leading
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform serif family used across all roles with variation in color and scale.
graphicDevices: Circular record label logo in the upper right quadrant

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy but elegant mid-century serif look.
Provides the heavy weight and bracketed serifs seen in the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a dark suit and white shirt with a black tie, centered against a soft, light blue gradient background. Ensure the lighting is soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add high-contrast serif text in the top left (stacked, brown and magenta) and top right (stacked, blue). Include a small list of text in the middle left in a smaller font size.

verificationChecks: Is the background a clean blue gradient?
Are there distinct color blocks for the text?
Is the typography a high-contrast serif?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not touch the subject's head.
Verify the blue background is smooth and free of artifacts.
Ensure the suit is a deep, solid charcoal or black.
Confirm the serif font has sharp, visible serifs.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Blue Gradient + Asymmetrical Serif Typography
